title: 真假金丝雀的博弈第12章
content_zh:
第12章 单刀赴会

    周二上午九点，我站在万盛集团总部的大堂里。

    前台小姐看了我一眼，职业微笑：“请问有预约吗？”

    “没有。告诉许向平，温暖找他。”

    她愣了一下。不是因为我没有预约，是因为我直呼了她老板的全名。她犹豫了两秒，拨了内线，压低声音说了几句话，然后抬起头，表情里多了一点掩饰不住的惊讶。

    “许总在十八楼会议室等您。”

    我走进电梯，按下十八。电梯镜面里映出一个穿黑色西装裙的女人，手里拎着一个文件袋，里面装着许向平的转账记录、顾明珠的短信截图，还有顾西辞花了两个月整理的那份黑色档案。今天早上出门前我对着镜子站了整整五分钟，把阿May教我的那套心法默念了三遍——表情要稳，眼神要冷，说话要慢。对方越急你越慢，对方越气你越笑。

    电梯门开了。

    十八楼的走廊很长，铺着深灰色的地毯。尽头是一扇半开的会议室门，里面传来说话声。不是一个人，是两个人。一个是许向平，另一个是女人的声音。

    我走到门口，推门进去。

    许向平坐在会议桌主位上，面前摊着一堆文件。坐在他对面的女人穿着一件藕荷色的真丝衬衫，头发挽成低发髻，耳边坠着两颗珍珠。

    林曼如。

    他们夫妻俩同时看向我，表情截然不同。许向平的脸沉下来，眉头拧成一团。林曼如的眼睛亮了一下，然后迅速恢复了那副温婉贤淑的惯常表情，但她嘴角的那个弧度我认识——她在憋笑。

    “温小姐，什么风把你吹到万盛来了？”许向平把钢笔放下，靠在椅背上。

    “许总，我来是有正事。”我看了林曼如一眼，“林太太也在，正好。”

    “正好什么？”

    “正好当个见证。”

    我把文件袋放在桌上，没急着打开。许向平的目光在我和文件袋之间来回扫了两遍，然后把钢笔拿起来又放下。焦虑。他每次焦虑就会反复摆弄手边的东西，上次在高尔夫球场是香槟杯，这次是钢笔。

    “打开看看吧。”我把文件袋推过去。

    许向平没有伸手。他盯着我看了五秒钟，那五秒钟里他的眼睛里闪过了很多东西——怀疑、警惕、还有一丝不易察觉的恐惧。然后他伸手打开文件袋，抽出里面的文件。第一页就是顾明珠的银行转账记录截图。三笔，时间和金额都用红笔圈了出来。

    他的手停在半空。

    “你什么意思？”

    “许总应该比我清楚。”

    “我不清楚。”

    “那就我来帮您回忆。第一笔转账，您给顾明珠转了钱，同一天晚上她告诉您认亲宴上会宣布婚约。第二笔，认亲宴当天早上转的。第三笔，上周末。三笔转账，收款人是同一个。您觉得如果这些东西被顾家的人看到了，会怎么想？”

    许向平的脸色变了。他把文件翻到下一页，下一页是顾明珠和许向平的短信记录截图。更短的几条消息，但每一条都够致命。许向平问她认亲宴流程，她答了。许向平说“你很聪明，继续合作”，她回了一个“好”字。

    “你从哪里弄到的？”

    “这不重要。重要的是这些信息如果同时出现在顾先生和林董的桌上，您会有什么后果。”

    “你敢——”

    “敢什么？”我看着他的眼睛，“敢把你在顾家插眼线的事捅出去？敢告诉林子明他女婿花钱收买顾家内部消息？还是敢让你太太亲眼看看你背着她做了什么事？”

    林曼如从旁边伸出手，从许向平面前把那几页纸抽过去。她低头看了片刻，然后慢慢放下，看着许向平。

    “向平，这就是你说的商业竞争？”

    “曼如——”

    “你说你跟顾西辞的竞争是光明正大的。你说温小姐在球场上挑衅你。你说你只是正当反击。”她把那几页纸放在桌上，声音不高，但每个字都很稳，“收买一个小姑娘套消息，叫光明正大？”

    许向平站起来，椅子往后滑了半米撞到墙上发出沉闷的一声响。

    “你站在谁那边？”

    “我不站谁。我站事实。”林曼如站起来，把包挎在肩上，“我来找你是因为秦岳撤资的事，但秦岳已经把你的嘴脸告诉我了。我本来不信。现在信了。”

    “你信谁？信她还是信我？”

    “信我自己的眼睛。你在外面做的事，我一个一个都看到了。以前我不说是给你留面子。但从你背着我开画廊的那天起，你就不需要我的面子了。”她说完看了我一眼，微微点了点头，转身走了。

    会议室的门在她身后合上。许向平站在原地，手掌撑着桌面，低着头，呼吸很重。

    我把另一份文件从文件袋里抽出来。这份是顾西辞整理的黑档案，没全部打印，我只挑了五页。许向平近三年在万盛并购案里的回扣记录、关联交易的资金流向、还有一笔通过海外账户进行的灰色操作。

Chapter 12 Going to the meeting alone

    At nine o'clock on Tuesday morning, I stood in the lobby of the Wansheng Group headquarters.

    The lady at the front desk glanced at me and smiled professionally: "Do you have an appointment?"

    "No. Tell Xu Xiangping that Nuan Nuan is looking for him."

    She was stunned for a moment. Not because I didn’t have an appointment, but because I called her boss by his full name. She hesitated for two seconds, dialed the internal number, said a few words in a low voice, and then raised her head, with a little more surprise on her expression that could not be concealed.

    "Mr. Xu is waiting for you in the conference room on the 18th floor."

    I walked into the elevator and pressed eighteen. The elevator mirror reflected a woman in a black suit and skirt, holding a document bag in her hand, which contained Xu Xiangping's transfer records, screenshots of Gu Mingzhu's text messages, and the black file that Gu Xici spent two months compiling. This morning before I went out, I stood in front of the mirror for five minutes and silently recited the mental technique that May taught me three times - my expression should be steady, my eyes should be cold, and I should speak slowly. The more anxious the other person is, the slower you will be. The angrier the other person is, the more you will laugh.

    The elevator door opens.

    The corridor on the 18th floor is very long and covered with dark gray carpet. At the end was a half-open conference room door, and voices could be heard from inside. Not one person, but two people. One is Xu Xiangping, and the other is a woman's voice.

    I walked to the door and pushed it open.

    Xu Xiangping sat at the head of the conference table with a pile of documents spread out in front of him. The woman sitting opposite him was wearing a lotus-colored silk shirt, her hair was pulled into a low bun, and there were two pearls hanging in her ears.

    Lin Manru.

    The couple looked at me at the same time, with completely different expressions. Xu Xiangping's face darkened and his brows knitted together. Lin Manru's eyes lit up for a moment, and then she quickly returned to her usual gentle and virtuous expression, but I recognized the curve at the corner of her mouth - she was suppressing a smile.

    "Miss Wen, what brought you to Wansheng?" Xu Xiangping put down his pen and leaned on the back of his chair.

    "Mr. Xu, I'm here on business." I glanced at Lin Manru and said, "Mrs. Lin is here, just in time."

    "Exactly what?"

    "It just serves as a witness."

    I put the document bag on the table and didn't open it in a hurry. Xu Xiangping's eyes glanced back and forth between me and the document bag twice, then he picked up the pen and put it down again. anxiety. Whenever he is anxious, he will repeatedly fiddle with the things at hand. Last time it was a champagne glass on the golf course, this time it was a pen.

    "Open it and take a look." I pushed the document bag over.

    Xu Xiangping did not reach out. He stared at me for five seconds, and many things flashed through his eyes in those five seconds—suspiciousness, vigilance, and a hint of subtle fear. Then he reached out to open the document bag and pulled out the documents inside. The first page is a screenshot of Gu Mingzhu's bank transfer record. Three transactions, the time and amount were circled in red pen.

    His hand stopped in mid-air.

    "What do you mean?"

    "Mr. Xu should know better than me."

    "I don't know."

    "Then let me help you recall. In the first transfer, you transferred money to Gu Mingzhu, and on the same night she told you that the engagement would be announced at the recognition banquet. The second transfer was made in the morning of the recognition banquet. The third transfer was last weekend. The payee of the three transfers was the same. What do you think the Gu family would think if these things were seen?"

    Xu Xiangping's expression changed. He turned the file to the next page. The next page was a screenshot of the text message records between Gu Mingzhu and Xu Xiangping. A few shorter messages, but each one is deadly enough. Xu Xiangping asked her about the process of the marriage recognition banquet, and she answered. Xu Xiangping said, "You are very smart, continue to cooperate." She replied with a "good" word.

    "Where did you get it?"

    "It's not important. What's important is what consequences you would have if this information appeared on the desks of Mr. Gu and Director Lin at the same time."

    "How dare you—"

    "What dare you?" I looked into his eyes, "Dare to expose your spying in the Gu family? Dare you tell Lin Ziming that his son-in-law paid to buy inside information about the Gu family? Or dare you let your wife see with her own eyes what you did behind her back?"

    Lin Manru reached out from the side and pulled the pages away from Xu Xiangping. She looked down for a moment, then slowly put it down and looked at Xu Xiangping.

    "Xiang Ping, is this the business competition you're talking about?"

    "Manru——"

    "You said that the competition between you and Gu Xici was fair and aboveboard. You said that Miss Wen provoked you on the court. You said that you were just fighting back." She put the pages on the table, her voice was low but every word was steady, "Buying a little girl to trick you is fair and square?"

    Xu Xiangping stood up, and his chair slid back half a meter and hit the wall with a dull sound.

    "Whose side are you on?"

    "I don't stand for anyone. I stand for the facts." Lin Manru stood up and put her bag on her shoulder. "I came to you because of Qin Yue's divestment, but Qin Yue has already told me your face. I didn't believe it at first. I believe it now."

    "Who do you believe? Her or me?"

    "Believe my own eyes. I have seen everything you did outside. I didn't say it before to save face for you. But from the day you opened the gallery behind my back, you no longer need my face." She finished.
